author: Amut S
title: Super Tour
text: Our 3 days Trip ( Fez to Marrakesh was an absolutely wounderful trip! Clean car, very good organisation in time , distance ,places of interest and hotel .. But best of all was our excellent and professional driver Hassan!!!! From the first moment , we met him , until the moment we said goodbye , he took care of us with full attention , very friendly , helpful ,responsible , sharing with us his wide knowledge of his culture and the history! Thank you , Hassan , so much.. !!! These three days were an amazing and deep experience , I never will forget! Wish you all the best .. Almut

author: Gloria M
title: The best trip with Hassan Oumouch
text: We traveled with Hassan Oumouch and it couldn't have been better. He was always friendly, courteous and helpful. He is a very safe driver. In addition, we could ask him anything and always got a professional answer. He also knows the different areas: customs, traditions, agriculture, geography and more. If we come back to Morocco, we would travel with him again. He was like a friend and made special routes for us and put in shops when we wanted to take photos. Gloria Meyet

author: DLOttawa
title: Great 11 day tour of Morocco
text: We just finished an eleven-day tour offered by Atlas tours in which Mohammed was our driver and principal guide, from Casablanca through to the Sahara, and concluding in Marrakesh. It was wonderful, and everything about it, from the locations to the accommodation, was carefully thought out and designed for our interests. Mohammed was a skilful driver with an obvious array of good contacts in every place we visited. He was able to deviate from our planned route on a couple of occasions to accommodate things that arose on the fly. He helped us negotiate a few purchases and advise on local customs. He was flexible on timing and knew how to adjust the schedule to suit our ages and eating habits. I would have no hesitation in recommending Atlas tours and Mohammed to anyone interested in this longer, personal tour of the country.

author: Basya
title: Epic desert tour ?
text: My friend and I took a 3 day desert trip while in Morocco. Starting in Marrakech, we travelled through Ouarzazate and Merzouga before heading to Fes- stopping at the most beautiful sights along the way. Atlas tours actually came highly recommended by friends of ours and they definitely lived up to the hype! Prior to the trip we had a lot of detailed questions. Shoutout to Lachsan who was so responsive and answered each one with so much patience. Youssef, our private driver was super nice and easygoing. We felt really safe and comfortable with him. He answered so many of our questions and was pretty much our photographer too! Traveling the desert with Atlas Tours is the best thing we ever did. I cannot recommend them enough :)

author: Hemini T
title: Atlas Mountain day trip
text: We did the Atlas Mountain all day tour as 5 Adults with the lovely Ahmad! He was so fluent with his English, explained things to us and looked after my mum from the start of the hike up the mountains to the bottom. Ahmad is very well mannered, we would love to do another tour again with him. He was so friendly and made sure we were all okay throughout the trip. Thank you Ahmad, we give you 10 stars with the excellent service you gave us! Keep up the good work!

author: PaulineR0722
title: Trip de 3 jours entre Marrakech et Merzouga
text: Retour sur 3 jours qui resteront dans nos mémoires! Le premier jour nous avons débuté la route de Marrakech avec notre chauffeur Hassan. Nous avons emprunté la route du Tizi N’Tichka, puis nous sommes allés jusqu’à la Kasbah de Telouet. Nous nous sommes arrêtés pour manger face à Ait Benhaddou puis nous avons visité ce magnifique Ksar qui fut le théâtre de bon nombre de films. Notre périple a continué passant par Ouarzazate et terminant par une nuit dans un super Riad dans la vallée du Dades. Au matin du 2eme jour, nous avons repris la route pour aller voir les gorges du Dades puis celles du Todra. Nous sommes passés près de l’immense oasis du Tafilalt avec un petit détour par Rissani ou nous avons pu déguster les meilleures dattes! Après Rissani, direction Merzouga! L’image des dunes nous trotte déjà dans la tête … malgré un temps couvert à l’arrivée cette étendue de sable était fascinante! Nous voilà déposées dans la sable prêtes à essayer un nouveau moyen de locomotion: le dromadaire !! C’est parti pour 1h30 de chevauchée afin de gagner notre campement pour la nuit. Nous étions toutes les 3 bouche bée face à ce paysage si exceptionnel. Le camp était tout simplement surréaliste, on aurait pu se croire parachuté directement dans l’univers d’Aladin ! Nous avons très bien mangé puis nous avons terminé la soirée autour du feu au son des tambours et des chants berbères! 3eme jour: levé aux aurores afin de pouvoir admirer le levé du soleil depuis le haut d’une dune. C’est un si beau spectacle qu’il vous mettrait presque la larme à l’œil …! Après avoir profité de ce beau moment dans les dunes nous sommes rentrées prendre le petit déjeuner au camp et nous avons repris la route (en ayant toutefois pris le temps de faire un peu de 4x4 dans les dunes!!! ) Sur la route du retour (différente que celle de l’aller) on se croit dans la savane, vous vous imaginez presque que des girafes et des éléphants vont apparaître d’un moment à l’autre. Nous sommes passés par la vallée du Draa puis nous avons repris la route du Tichka jusqu’à Marrakech. Il faut certes faire beaucoup de route pendant ce trip mais ça en vaut la peine!!! Notre chauffeur s’est arrêté souvent pour qu’on puisse faire des photos, manger un morceau, ou juste faire une petite pause ce qui rend la route beaucoup plus facile! Hassan a été très gentil, prévenant et drôle. C’est un très bon chauffeur! La voiture était très confortable! Partez dans le désert avec Atlas Private Tour vous ne serez pas déçus!

author: Antoniu
title: Barak, my friend from Morroco
text: We had a wonderful trip through the Sahara desert in the company of a great man that we now call friend, Barak. The trip was beyond expectations as he did his best to make us feel welcomed and happy. His car was very comfortable, I’m not sure but I think it is new. He is a very good driver and we felt safe all the way. Beside this he helped us with all sorts of tips and tricks. Unfortunately because of this pandemic times we had to make a PCR test ‘on the last minute’. He helped us with this even if this was not his job. He got us to a testing centre. Without him we would not have been able to do the test in time and couldn’t get home as planned. So for this we are forever grateful.

author: IonutC
title: Morocco full experience
text: We were picked up from our Fes hotel.We met our lovely guide, Nbarak and he led us through a variety of cool stories and activities. The road trip was very good and we felt safe all the time. We also got very good tips and tricks and some reasonable prices for all the stops we had.The desert trip was worth all the money and we were on schedule all the time.Due to COVID situation, we got into trouble with our flight and so on, but we had help all the way from our new friend, so we were very grateful for that!Thanks again for everything!

author: Larisa C
title: Barak - the most friendly guide
text: We had the pleasure to have a 3 days trip from Fes to Marrakech in the company of Barak.During this time, he was more than a guide, he became our friend. He received us with joy in his life, family and country. He did all for us to have an interesting, exotic and unique experience. I recommend Barak from Altas Private Tour with all my heart.

author: Mariuspt
title: 5-star is too litle
text: We took the 3 days desert tour from Fes to Marrakech with Mbarack and it was wonderful. The tour was very balanced, well organized and every activity and accomodation on the way were very good. But the best part was the tour guide who by the end of the tour became our friend. Also, since the trip happened in the awful Coronavirus times, when restrictions were constantly changing, we needed fast PCR tests, which Mbarack helped us take in due time. A big thank you for all your help and for the wonderful 3 days in the desert!
